Dr. Mercola Has Been Providing Quality Products Since 2001
Contrary to popular opinion, declining eyesight isn’t a result of growing older. Rather, it’s often a side effect of our modern lifestyle – and a lack of the nutrients your eyes need to thrive.
Smoking, obesity, blood sugar and blood pressure issues as well as lack of sleep can hasten a decline in your ability to see clearly.
Too many hours of screen time with its potentially harmful short-wavelength blue light can also take its toll on your eye health and visual acuity and comfort over time.
To help you support your eyesight and eye health through these kinds of challenging conditions, we formulated Eye Support with four of the most powerful ingredients:
Anthocyanins from Black Currant Extract are one of the newest groups of antioxidants recognized for their powerful eye support benefits. They are easily absorbed into your plasma and eye tissue to nourish your eyes and help provide support against visual fatigue.
Lutein is a naturally-occurring carotenoid that is used by your body as an antioxidant and provides valuable support for your eyes by absorbing harmful blue light from electronic devices, fighting free radicals and protecting cells from oxidative damage.
Zeaxanthin is the strongest antioxidant carotenoid found in your retina and moves easily into eye tissues. Together with Lutein, it significantly increases macular pigment density for visual acuity and helps ease common visual complaints.
Organic Astaxanthin from Haematococcus pluvialis microalga, the preferred source, readily crosses into the tissues of your eyes and promotes optimal eye energy levels and visual acuity while supporting your retina during bright light exposures.
Based on scientific research, our formula contains the optimal doses of these ingredients for effective protection against damaging free radicals and for promoting optimal macula and retina health.
It is also free of synthetic ingredients, as our Organic Astaxanthin is grown in a pure, toxin-free environment and extracted without solvents.
We’ve taken the guesswork out of finding the right combination of botanicals for healthy eyes and vision. Use Eye Support with confidence to help maintain your healthy eyesight.
Suggested use
Adults, as a dietary supplement, take one (1) capsule daily.
